title: Re-mapping of keys gets jumbled when multiple keyboard languages are used.
author: tallabomba
summary: Remaps are virtual-key based and therefore do not maintain separate mappings per active keyboard layout; the requested layout-aware behavior is tracked in #9767.
next_action: Consolidate layout-dependent remapping under #9767 instead of opening a separate bug fix.

confidence.rationale: The public discussion and linked ownership evidence support this classification.

judgment.rationale: Keyboard Manager stores virtual-key remaps independent of the active input layout; layout-specific remapping is an enhancement already tracked by canonical issue #9767.
evidence: The screenshots show the same physical keys displaying different characters after switching Swedish/English layouts.
A contributor explains that Keyboard Manager operates on virtual keys.
Issue #19781 was closed as a duplicate of open enhancement #9767 for remapping based on input language.
judgment.recommended_action: Consolidate layout-dependent remapping under #9767 instead of opening a separate bug fix.

fix_assessment.rationale: The requested behavior is an enhancement tracked by #9767; the current artifact should not propose a parallel bug fix.

issue_context.summary: Remaps are virtual-key based and therefore do not maintain separate mappings per active keyboard layout; the requested layout-aware behavior is tracked in #9767.
known_information: Swedish, English, Russian, and Thai layout use cases are described.
The remaps continue to operate on virtual-key identities while displayed characters change with layout.
A fresh confirmation in 2024 says the behavior persists.
inferences: The reported 'jumbled' mappings are the consequence of a layout-independent virtual-key model rather than corrupted saved data.
Supporting per-layout remaps requires product-level layout awareness and belongs with the existing enhancement.
issue_context.analysis: The discussion now clearly distinguishes current virtual-key behavior from the requested layout-dependent feature. No new bug design should compete with #9767.
initial_investigation: Reviewed all live comments, screenshots, diagnostic attachment references, and the maintainer's duplicate linkage.
Verified #9767 remains open and #19781 was closed as its duplicate.

actions.label: Close as layout-aware remapping duplicate
actions.note: Draft only; no comment, close, label, or other write was made to microsoft/PowerToys.

comment.body: Thanks for the detailed Swedish/English and Russian/English examples. Keyboard Manager currently stores virtual-key remaps rather than separate mappings for each active input layout, so the displayed/output characters can change when the layout changes. Layout-dependent remapping is tracked in #9767; this issue can be closed as a duplicate so the scenarios and priority stay consolidated there.
